title: Modric 'ashamed' of Croatia's 'catastrophic night'
summary: Croatia captain Luka Modric expressed shame over his team's performance in a Nations League match against England, calling it a "catastrophic night." The result highlights Croatia's significant struggles in the competition.
content: Croatia captain Luka Modric says he was "ashamed" of his side's performance on a "catastrophic night" against England.

zh.title: 莫德里奇为克罗地亚"灾难性的夜晚"感到"羞愧"
zh.summary: 克罗地亚队长卢卡·莫德里奇对他的球队在欧洲国家联赛对阵英格兰的比赛中的表现感到羞愧，称其为"灾难性的夜晚"。这个结果凸显了克罗地亚在该赛事中面临的重大困难。

title: Gerrard has 'nothing but respect' for McInnes - gossip
summary: Former Rangers manager Steven Gerrard expressed respect for current Ibrox boss McInnes, hoping the manager becomes successful enough that Gerrard's return would be unnecessary. The comment reflects positive sentiment within Rangers about their current leadership.
content: Former Rangers boss hopes current Ibrox manager can be so successful that there will be no need for him to return...

zh.title: 杰拉德对麦金尼斯"只有尊重" - 八卦
zh.summary: 前游骑兵队主教练史蒂文·杰拉德表达了对现任埃布罗克斯主教练麦金尼斯的尊重，希望该教练的成功程度足以使杰拉德的回归成为不必要的。这一评论反映了游骑兵队内部对其当前领导层的积极情绪。

title: Bowie seizing Scotland shot after World Cup disappointment
summary: Kieron Bowie scored his first goal for Scotland against North Macedonia, building momentum after the team's World Cup disappointment. His breakthrough goal demonstrates growing confidence in the Scottish national team.
content: BBC Scotland speaks to Kieron Bowie after he scores his first goal for his country against North Macedonia.

zh.title: 鲍伊在世界杯失望后为苏格兰把握机会
zh.summary: 基隆·鲍伊在对阵北马其顿的比赛中为苏格兰打入首球，在球队世界杯失望后积累了势头。他的突破性进球展示了苏格兰国家队不断增长的自信心。

title: I clawed my way to the top but need a break - Azpilicueta
summary: Cesar Azpilicueta announced his retirement after a glorious 20-year career that included captaining Chelsea to multiple titles. The Spanish defender's departure marks the end of an influential era at the club.
content: Cesar Azpilicueta says it is time to move to "a different stage of life" following a glorious 20-year playing career, notably captaining Chelsea to several titles.

zh.title: 我一步步登上巅峰，但现在需要休息 - 阿斯皮利奎塔
zh.summary: 塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔宣布在20年辉煌职业生涯后退役，期间他曾担任切尔西队长并随队赢得多个冠军。这位西班牙后卫的离队标志着该俱乐部一个有影响力时代的终结。

title: Flex your football brain with our daily quizzes
summary: BBC Football offers daily quizzes including "Who Am I?", "Five in Five", and "Brainteaser" challenges to test readers' football knowledge. This recurring feature provides interactive engagement for fans.
content: Test your football knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

zh.title: 通过我们的每日测验展示你的足球知识
zh.summary: BBC足球频道提供每日测验，包括"我是谁？"、"五合五"和"智力挑战"等问题，以测试读者的足球知识。这个定期更新的栏目为球迷提供了互动参与的机会。

title: Wales aiming to prove they can thrive at top level
summary: Wales captain Ben Davies said his team will be driven to prove they can compete at the highest level when facing Denmark in Nations League A at Cardiff. The match represents a key opportunity for Wales to demonstrate their credentials.
content: Captain Ben Davies says Wales will be driven by determination to prove they can live with challenges of Nations League A when they face Denmark in Cardiff.

zh.title: 威尔士力图证明他们能在最高水平竞争
zh.summary: 威尔士队长本·戴维斯表示，当球队在卡迪夫面对丹麦进行欧洲国家联赛A级联赛比赛时，他们将致力于证明自己能在最高水平竞争。这场比赛对威尔士来说是展示实力的关键机会。
